posts.title: How Best to Understand What God Is Really Like?
posts.description: by Mike Edwards Moral intuition is a primary guide If a religious teaching contradicts universal moral intuition, it should be questioned. Our innate sense of good and evil is not inferior to ancient texts. Moral intuition helps us discern God’s character more reliably than rigid interpretations of Scripture. But the Bible Scripture requires interpretation and is not always definitive. Even if you believe the Bible is inspired by God and the writers understood God perfectly and God controlled their thinking – no one can claim perfect interpretation. Christians interpret differently passages about hell, women, and LGBTQ+ people in opposite ways. Therefore, dogmatic certainty about God’s nature based solely on Scripture is unwarranted. What are some common beliefs to reject based on moral intuitions Portrayals of God that justify the following arise from human interpretation, not God’s true character intuitively speaking: eternal torture in hell What Are The Worst Lies About God – Hell?

posts.title: What Is The Worst Belief About The Bible?
posts.description: by Mike Edwards Many Christians believe the Bible is the inspired word of God. Did God really control writings rather than simply motivate writers to record God’s history. It is doubtful God controlled writings because God is all-loving and controlling is not loving. Writers may not have understood God perfectly. I believe it is wiser to assume the Bible isn’t inspired by God See here. Uncertainty more likely leads to discussing which interpretations more accurately portrays a loving God. What matters the most is avoiding thinking your interpretations are inspired/certain. God may not agree all that is written about God in the Bible. And, Bible scholars do not agree on the same interpretation of many moral issues in the Bible. It is rarely admitted that one’s interpretative views of God according to the Bible could be right or wrong. posts.title: Parenting Tips From Our Experience:
posts.description: by Mike Edwards I know this is supposed to be a spiritual blog, but when your kids don’t ask for your advice then you have to express it somewhere. I don’t blame them. How many older men I respect have I reached out for advice how to age gracefully? Anyway, what would I say to others if they dared to ask for parenting advise. None of my kids are in jail and we have a good relationship though in their forties, but honestly perfect parenting doesn’t guarantee perfect children. Just ask God about his children! God God has been our greatest influence in parenting. God’s way of loving is surely the best so imitate God the best way you know. Just stay close to God and we are convinced God will influence your ways positively. Keep in mind the main three stages of parenting Ages 0-2: Total Dependence so just love, feed, try to get them to sleep Ages 2-11: Time to discipline as kids are seeking to be independent and need help.
